title: 奇亚娜 · 圆环花架
description: 卷发奇亚娜在花园摆放花盆，标志圆环刃靠在藤架旁。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Qiyana is an adult woman with warm brown skin, pale silver hair, a small golden crown, and a confident playful expression. She wears a fully covering turquoise-and-gold ceremonial dress with opaque leggings, alongside her large recognizable circular elemental blade with smooth jewel-colored edges.
art_direction.scene: She stands beside a simple garden table, turning one terracotta flowerpot toward the sunshine. The circular blade rests securely against a wooden trellis as a still display prop, echoing the round pot and a few soft green leaves. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: turquoise, jade green, pale silver, gold, terracotta
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
